jwt.title: JSON web token (JWT) generator
jwt.description: Enter the JWT secret. A JWT will be generated in the browser, stored in the chatbotAccessToken cookie, set to expire after 30 minutes, and automatically refreshed every 25 minutes.
jwt.help: This secret must match the backend JWT secret if backend JWT authentication is enabled.
notification.jwtGeneratedBody: A new JWT has been generated and stored in the chatbotAccessToken cookie.
dropzone.dragDropSingle: Drag and drop PDF file here
dropzone.dragDropMultiple: Drag and drop PDF files here
dropzone.aria: Upload PDF files by browsing or dragging and dropping
citation.title: Citation Generator
citation.description: Select a PDF file and choose the desired citation style. The generated citation will be added to the chat history.
summary.title: Summary Generator
summary.description: Select a PDF file and choose the summary language. The generated summary will be added to the chat history.
upload.title: Upload to Vector Database
upload.description: Select one or more PDF files to upload and index in the vector database. A status message will be added to the chat history.
notification.uploadFailedBody: Unable to upload one or more PDF files.
rag.title: RAG Query
rag.description: Enter a question to query the vector database and generate an AI response based on retrieved document context.
rag.help: The response will be added to the chat history as an assistant message.
